name: openclaw-plugin-esp-serial-relay

scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run build && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js

description: Flash and monitor ESP boards from any tailnet machine — one browser tab holds the serial line over RFC2217, with a live phase panel, write progress, and capture/replay. No extra software on the desk.
